name: Neural Prefiltering for Correlation-Aware Levels of Detail
definition: The method avoids assumptions on particular types of geometry or materials, bypassing special-case decompositions by directly learning a compressed representation of the intra-voxel light transport using neural networks.
summary: Neural Prefiltering for Correlation-Aware Levels of Detail is a physically-based rendering method that decomposes light transport into learned visibility and throughput functions to enable multi-scale rendering while retaining visibility correlations to prevent light leaks.
